map.肩屈曲正常 max 180°，实测 150°：达成率=150/180×100=8: Shoulder flexion normal max is 180 degrees, measured 150 degrees: achievement rate = 150/180 x 100 = 83%, mildly limited, target restoring to above 170 degrees.
map.膝伸正常 0°，实测 -5°（过伸 5°内属正常变异），无挛缩；若< -10°: Knee extension normal is 0 degrees, measured -5 degrees (hyperextension within 5 degrees is a normal variant), no contracture; below -10 degrees indicates a flexion contracture.
map.达成率怎么算？: How is the achievement rate calculated?
map.实测角/该动作正常最大值×100；<80% 为明显受限，<50% 严重影响功能，: Measured angle / normal maximum for that movement x 100; below 80% is clearly limited, below 50% seriously impairs function and stretching should be prioritized.
map.左右差多少有意义？: How large a left-right difference is meaningful?
map.通常双侧差异大于 10°、或与年龄性别对应的正常值相差大于 15–20° 才认为: Usually a bilateral difference above 10 degrees, or a gap of more than 15-20 degrees from the normal value for the matching age and sex, is considered clinically meaningful; below that range it is mostly measurement error or individual variation. When measuring you must fix the position, use the same goniometer and the same bony landmarks, and record passive and active ROM separately, because a large gap between the two suggests muscle weakness or pain inhibition rather than a limitation of the joint itself.
